    def update(self, delta_time: float):
        """Main game update loop"""
        self.delta_time = delta_time
        self.time += delta_time
        
        # Update each robot
        for robot_id, robot in list(self.robots.items()):
            if not robot.is_alive:
                continue
            
            # Update cooldown
            robot.update_cooldown(delta_time)
            
            # Update power-ups
            robot.update_power_ups(delta_time)
            
            # Get AI decision
            action = self.behavior_engine.decide_action(robot)
            
            # Execute action
            self.execute_action(robot, action)
            
            # Update knowledge base
            self.update_knowledge_base(robot)
        
        # Update objectives
        for obj_id, objective in list(self.objectives.items()):
            # Get robots in range of objective
            robots_in_range = [
                r for r in self.robots.values() 
                if r.is_alive and r.position.distance_to(objective.position) < objective.radius
            ]
            objective.update(delta_time, robots_in_range)
            
            # Check if objective was captured
            if objective.is_captured() and objective.captured_by is not None:
                self.stats.objectives_completed[objective.type] += 1
                self.stats.update_team_score(objective.captured_by, 10)
                self.audio_effects.put(("objective_captured", objective.position))
        
        # Update power-ups
        for powerup_id, powerup in list(self.powerups.items()):
            if powerup.active:
                # Check if any robot is close enough to pick it up
                for robot in self.robots.values():
                    if (robot.is_alive and 
                        robot.position.distance_to(powerup.position) < 50):
                        # Apply power-up effect
                        robot.apply_power_up(powerup.type, powerup.duration, powerup.value)
                        powerup.active = False
                        self.audio_effects.put(("powerup_collected", powerup.position))
                        self.stats.add_robot_stat(robot.id, "powerups_collected", 1)
                        break
        
        # Update hazards
        for hazard_id, hazard in list(self.hazards.items()):
            if hazard.active:
                # Check if any robot is in hazard zone
                for robot in self.robots.values():
                    if (robot.is_alive and 
                        robot.position.distance_to(hazard.position) < hazard.radius):
                        # Apply damage
                        robot.take_damage(int(hazard.damage_per_second * delta_time))
                        self.audio_effects.put(("hazard_damage", robot.position))
                        self.stats.add_robot_stat(robot.id, "hazard_damage_taken", 1)
                
                # Check if hazard expired
                if self.time - hazard.spawn_time > hazard.duration:
                    hazard.active = False
                    self.audio_effects.put(("hazard_expired", hazard.position))
        
        # Update game stats
        self.stats.game_time = self.time
        self.update_adaptive_difficulty()
        
        # Check for game end conditions
        self.check_game_end()

        if not robot.is_alive or not robot.can_act():

@dataclass
class Vector2:
    """2D Vector for position and movement"""
    x: float = 0.0
    y: float = 0.0
    
    def __add__(self, other):
        return Vector2(self.x + other.x, self.y + other.y)
    
    def __sub__(self, other):
        return Vector2(self.x - other.x, self.y - other.y)
    
    def __mul__(self, scalar):
        return Vector2(self.x * scalar, self.y * scalar)
    
    def length(self):
        return math.sqrt(self.x**2 + self.y**2)
    
    def normalize(self):
        len_val = self.length()
        if len_val == 0:
            return Vector2(0, 0)
        return Vector2(self.x / len_val, self.y / len_val)
    
    def distance_to(self, other):
        return (self - other).length()

@dataclass

        """Apply a power-up effect to the robot"""
        self.power_ups[power_type] = duration
        if power_type == PowerUpType.SPEED_BOOST:
            self.speed *= value
        elif power_type == PowerUpType.DAMAGE_BOOST:
            # This would affect the robot's weapon damage - stored in a separate field in a more complex system
            pass
        elif power_type == PowerUpType.SHIELD:
            # Shield would be implemented as temporary invulnerability
            pass
    
    def update_power_ups(self, delta_time: float):
        """Update active power-ups and remove expired ones"""
        for power_type in list(self.power_ups.keys()):
            if self.power_ups[power_type] > 0:
                self.power_ups[power_type] -= delta_time
                if self.power_ups[power_type] <= 0:
                    # Remove expired power-up
                    self.power_ups[power_type] = 0
                    # Revert speed if speed boost expired
                    if power_type == PowerUpType.SPEED_BOOST:
                        self.speed = ROBOT_SPEED

        """Apply damage to the robot"""
        if not self.is_alive:

        self.health -= damage
        if self.health <= 0:
            self.health = 0
            self.is_alive = False
            self.last_action = "died"
    
    def heal(self, amount: int):
        """Heal the robot"""
        if not self.is_alive:
            return
        self.health = min(self.max_health, self.health + amount)
    
    def can_act(self) -> bool:
        """Check if robot is ready to perform an action"""
        return self.is_alive and self.cooldown <= 0
    
    def update_cooldown(self, delta_time: float):
        """Update cooldown timer"""
        if self.cooldown > 0:

            if self.cooldown < 0:
                self.cooldown = 0
    
    def get_behavior_score(self) -> float:
        """Calculate a behavioral score based on past performance"""
        if not self.knowledge_base:
            return 0.5
        
        # Score based on kills, assists, objective completion, survival
        kills = sum(1 for entry in self.knowledge_base if entry.get('action') == 'kill')
        assists = sum(1 for entry in self.knowledge_base if entry.get('action') == 'assist')
        objectives = sum(1 for entry in self.knowledge_base if entry.get('action') == 'objective')
        survival = sum(entry.get('survived', 0) for entry in self.knowledge_base)
        total_battles = len(self.knowledge_base)
        
        if total_battles == 0:
            return 0.5
        
        score = (kills * 0.4 + assists * 0.3 + objectives * 0.2 + survival * 0.1) / total_battles
        return max(0.1, min(0.9, score))  # Clamp between 0.1 and 0.9

class Objective:
    """Represents a team-based objective in the arena"""
    id: int
    type: ObjectiveType
    position: Vector2
    team_required: Optional[int] = None  # None for neutral objectives
    captured_by: Optional[int] = None  # team_id that captured it
    progress: float = 0.0  # 0.0 to 1.0
    radius: float = 100.0
    capture_rate: float = 0.01  # per second
    defense_points: int = 5  # for base defense
    
    def is_captured(self) -> bool:
        return self.captured_by is not None
    
    def capture(self, team_id: int) -> bool:
        """Attempt to capture objective"""
        if self.type == ObjectiveType.BASE_DEFENSE:
            # Can only capture if defense points are depleted
            if self.defense_points <= 0:
                self.captured_by = team_id
                return True
            return False
        else:
            # For other types, capture based on progress
            self.captured_by = team_id
            return True
    
    def update(self, delta_time: float, robots_in_range: List[Robot]):
        """Update objective state"""
        if self.is_captured():
            return
        
        # Calculate progress based on robots from the required team
        if self.team_required is not None:
            friendly_robots = [r for r in robots_in_range if r.team == self.team_required and r.is_alive]
            enemy_robots = [r for r in robots_in_range if r.team != self.team_required and r.is_alive]
            
            if friendly_robots and self.type == ObjectiveType.FLAG_CAPTURE:
                self.progress += len(friendly_robots) * self.capture_rate * delta_time
            elif enemy_robots and self.type == ObjectiveType.FLAG_CAPTURE:
                self.progress -= len(enemy_robots) * self.capture_rate * delta_time * 0.5
            
            # For base defense, count enemy robots near
            elif self.type == ObjectiveType.BASE_DEFENSE:
                self.defense_points -= len(enemy_robots) * delta_time * 0.5
                self.defense_points = max(0, self.defense_points)
            
            # For payload escort, progress if robots are near
            elif self.type == ObjectiveType.PAYLOAD_ESCORT:
                if friendly_robots:
                    self.progress += len(friendly_robots) * self.capture_rate * delta_time
                else:
                    self.progress -= delta_time * 0.005
            
            # Clamp progress
            self.progress = max(0.0, min(1.0, self.progress))
            
            # If objective is fully captured
            if self.progress >= 1.0:
                self.capture(self.team_required)

    def update(self, delta_time: float):
        """Main game update loop"""
        self.delta_time = delta_time
        self.time += delta_time
        
        # Update each robot
        for robot_id, robot in list(self.robots.items()):
            if not robot.is_alive:
                continue
            
            # Update cooldown
            robot.update_cooldown(delta_time)
            
            # Update power-ups
            robot.update_power_ups(delta_time)
            
            # Get AI decision
            action = self.behavior_engine.decide_action(robot)
            
            # Execute action
            self.execute_action(robot, action)
            
            # Update knowledge base
            self.update_knowledge_base(robot)
        
        # Update objectives
        for obj_id, objective in list(self.objectives.items()):
            # Get robots in range of objective
            robots_in_range = [
                r for r in self.robots.values() 
                if r.is_alive and r.position.distance_to(objective.position) < objective.radius
            ]
            objective.update(delta_time, robots_in_range)
            
            # Check if objective was captured
            if objective.is_captured() and objective.captured_by is not None:
                self.stats.objectives_completed[objective.type] += 1
                self.stats.update_team_score(objective.captured_by, 10)
                self.audio_effects.put(("objective_captured", objective.position))
        
        # Update power-ups
        for powerup_id, powerup in list(self.powerups.items()):
            if powerup.active:
                # Check if any robot is close enough to pick it up
                for robot in self.robots.values():
                    if (robot.is_alive and 
                        robot.position.distance_to(powerup.position) < 50):
                        # Apply power-up effect
                        robot.apply_power_up(powerup.type, powerup.duration, powerup.value)
                        powerup.active = False
                        self.audio_effects.put(("powerup_collected", powerup.position))
                        self.stats.add_robot_stat(robot.id, "powerups_collected", 1)
                        break
        
        # Update hazards
        for hazard_id, hazard in list(self.hazards.items()):
            if hazard.active:
                # Check if any robot is in hazard zone
                for robot in self.robots.values():
                    if (robot.is_alive and 
                        robot.position.distance_to(hazard.position) < hazard.radius):
                        # Apply damage
                        robot.take_damage(int(hazard.damage_per_second * delta_time))
                        self.audio_effects.put(("hazard_damage", robot.position))
                        self.stats.add_robot_stat(robot.id, "hazard_damage_taken", 1)
                
                # Check if hazard expired
                if self.time - hazard.spawn_time > hazard.duration:
                    hazard.active = False
                    self.audio_effects.put(("hazard_expired", hazard.position))
        
        # Update game stats
        self.stats.game_time = self.time
        self.update_adaptive_difficulty()
        
        # Check for game end conditions
        self.check_game_end()

@dataclass
class Vector2:
    """2D Vector for position and movement"""
    x: float = 0.0
    y: float = 0.0
    
    def __add__(self, other):
        return Vector2(self.x + other.x, self.y + other.y)
    
    def __sub__(self, other):
        return Vector2(self.x - other.x, self.y - other.y)
    
    def __mul__(self, scalar):
        return Vector2(self.x * scalar, self.y * scalar)
    
    def length(self):
        return math.sqrt(self.x**2 + self.y**2)
    
    def normalize(self):
        len_val = self.length()
        if len_val == 0:
            return Vector2(0, 0)
        return Vector2(self.x / len_val, self.y / len_val)
    
    def distance_to(self, other):
        return (self - other).length()

@dataclass

        """Apply a power-up effect to the robot"""
        self.power_ups[power_type] = duration
        if power_type == PowerUpType.SPEED_BOOST:

        elif power_type == PowerUpType.DAMAGE_BOOST:

            pass

            # Shield would be implemented as temporary invulnerability
            pass

        """Update active power-ups and remove expired ones"""
        for power_type in list(self.power_ups.keys()):
            if self.power_ups[power_type] > 0:
                self.power_ups[power_type] -= delta_time
                if self.power_ups[power_type] <= 0:
                    # Remove expired power-up
                    self.power_ups[power_type] = 0
                    # Revert speed if speed boost expired
                    if power_type == PowerUpType.SPEED_BOOST:
                        self.speed = ROBOT_SPEED
    
    def take_damage(self, damage: int):
        """Apply damage to the robot"""
        if not self.is_alive:

        self.health -= damage
        if self.health <= 0:

            self.is_alive = False
            self.last_action = "died"
    
    def heal(self, amount: int):

        if not self.is_alive:

        if total_battles == 0:

        score = (kills * 0.4 + assists * 0.3 + objectives * 0.2 + survival * 0.1) / total_battles

    def capture(self, team_id: int) -> bool:

        if self.type == ObjectiveType.BASE_DEFENSE:
            # Can only capture if defense points are depleted
            if self.defense_points <= 0:
                self.captured_by = team_id
                return True
            return False
        else:
            # For other types, capture based on progress
            self.captured_by = team_id
            return True
    
    def update(self, delta_time: float, robots_in_range: List[Robot]):

        if self.is_captured():

        if self.team_required is not None:
            friendly_robots = [r for r in robots_in_range if r.team == self.team_required and r.is_alive]

                self.progress += len(friendly_robots) * self.capture_rate * delta_time
            elif enemy_robots and self.type == ObjectiveType.FLAG_CAPTURE:

class RobotBehavior:

    def __init__(self, game_state: 'CyberArena'):
        self.game_state = game_state
        self.behavior_tree = {}

        self.behavior_tree = {

        """Check if robot needs to heal or retreat"""
        if robot.health < robot.max_health * 0.3 and robot.weapon != WeaponType.HEAL:

            nearby_heal = self.find_nearby_heal(robot)
            if nearby_heal:

            # Retreat to base or safe zone

        for other_robot in self.game_state.robots.values():

        for other_robot in self.game_state.robots.values():

                if dist < min_dist:

                    closest_enemy = other_robot

            elif distance <= ROBOT_RANGE and robot.weapon in [WeaponType.RANGED, WeaponType.SNIPER]:

            elif distance > ROBOT_RANGE:

        return None

        return None
    
    def find_nearest_enemy(self, robot: Robot) -> Optional[Robot]:
        """Find the closest enemy to a robot"""
        closest_enemy = None
        min_dist = float('inf')
        
        for other_robot in self.game_state.robots.values():
            if (other_robot.team != robot.team and 
                other_robot.is_alive):
                dist = robot.position.distance_to(other_robot.position)
                if dist < min_dist:
                    min_dist = dist
                    closest_enemy = other_robot
        
        return closest_enemy
    
    def patrol(self, robot: Robot) -> str:
        """Default patrol behavior"""
        # Patrol a predefined area based on role
        patrol_points = [
            Vector2(100, 100), Vector2(900, 100), Vector2(900, 700), Vector2(100, 700),
            Vector2(400, 200), Vector2(600, 600), Vector2(500, 400)
        ]
        
        # Assign patrol points based on team and role
        team_offset = robot.team % len(patrol_points)
        role_offset = robot.role.value[0]  # Use first letter of role as offset
        
        # Get patrol point based on team and role
        point_idx = (team_offset + role_offset) % len(patrol_points)
        target_pos = patrol_points[point_idx]
        
        # Move toward patrol point
        return f"patrol_{target_pos.x}_{target_pos.y}"
    
    def decide_action(self, robot: Robot) -> str:
        """Main decision function - returns the next action"""
        if not robot.is_alive:
            return "dead"
        
        # Update robot's knowledge with current state
        robot.last_action_time = time.time()
        
        # Go through behavior tree priorities
        for behavior in self.behavior_tree['priority']:
            action = behavior(robot)
            if action:
                robot.last_action = action
                return action
        
        # Default behavior
        return "patrol"

    def update(self, delta_time: float):
        """Main game update loop"""
        self.delta_time = delta_time
        self.time += delta_time
        
        # Update each robot
        for robot_id, robot in list(self.robots.items()):
            if not robot.is_alive:
                continue
            
            # Update cooldown
            robot.update_cooldown(delta_time)
            
            # Update power-ups
            robot.update_power_ups(delta_time)
            
            # Get AI decision
            action = self.behavior_engine.decide_action(robot)
            
            # Execute action
            self.execute_action(robot, action)
            
            # Update knowledge base
            self.update_knowledge_base(robot)
        
        # Update objectives
        for obj_id, objective in list(self.objectives.items()):
            # Get robots in range of objective
            robots_in_range = [
                r for r in self.robots.values() 
                if r.is_alive and r.position.distance_to(objective.position) < objective.radius
            ]
            objective.update(delta_time, robots_in_range)
            
            # Check if objective was captured
            if objective.is_captured() and objective.captured_by is not None:
                self.stats.objectives_completed[objective.type] += 1
                self.stats.update_team_score(objective.captured_by, 10)
                self.audio_effects.put(("objective_captured", objective.position))
        
        # Update power-ups
        for powerup_id, powerup in list(self.powerups.items()):
            if powerup.active:
                # Check if any robot is close enough to pick it up
                for robot in self.robots.values():
                    if (robot.is_alive and 
                        robot.position.distance_to(powerup.position) < 50):
                        # Apply power-up effect
                        robot.apply_power_up(powerup.type, powerup.duration, powerup.value)
                        powerup.active = False
                        self.audio_effects.put(("powerup_collected", powerup.position))
                        self.stats.add_robot_stat(robot.id, "powerups_collected", 1)
                        break
        
        # Update hazards
        for hazard_id, hazard in list(self.hazards.items()):
            if hazard.active:
                # Check if any robot is in hazard zone
                for robot in self.robots.values():
                    if (robot.is_alive and 
                        robot.position.distance_to(hazard.position) < hazard.radius):
                        # Apply damage
                        robot.take_damage(int(hazard.damage_per_second * delta_time))
                        self.audio_effects.put(("hazard_damage", robot.position))
                        self.stats.add_robot_stat(robot.id, "hazard_damage_taken", 1)
                
                # Check if hazard expired
                if self.time - hazard.spawn_time > hazard.duration:
                    hazard.active = False
                    self.audio_effects.put(("hazard_expired", hazard.position))
        
        # Update game stats
        self.stats.game_time = self.time
        self.update_adaptive_difficulty()
        
        # Check for game end conditions
        self.check_game_end()

        """Execute the AI's chosen action"""
        if not robot.is_alive or not robot.can_act():
            return

@dataclass
class Vector2:
    """2D Vector for position and movement"""
    x: float = 0.0
    y: float = 0.0
    
    def __add__(self, other):
        return Vector2(self.x + other.x, self.y + other.y)
    
    def __sub__(self, other):
        return Vector2(self.x - other.x, self.y - other.y)
    
    def __mul__(self, scalar):
        return Vector2(self.x * scalar, self.y * scalar)
    
    def length(self):
        return math.sqrt(self.x**2 + self.y**2)
    
    def normalize(self):
        len_val = self.length()
        if len_val == 0:
            return Vector2(0, 0)
        return Vector2(self.x / len_val, self.y / len_val)
    
    def distance_to(self, other):
        return (self - other).length()

@dataclass
class Robot:
    """Represents an AI-controlled robot in the arena"""
    id: int
    team: int
    position: Vector2
    health: int = ROBOT_HEALTH
    max_health: int = ROBOT_HEALTH
    speed: float = ROBOT_SPEED
    weapon: WeaponType = WeaponType.RANGED
    role: Role = Role.ATTACKER
    cooldown: float = 0.0
    is_alive: bool = True
    target: Optional[int] = None  # ID of target robot
    objective: Optional[ObjectiveType] = None
    power_ups: Dict[PowerUpType, float] = field(default_factory=dict)  # power-up type -> duration
    knowledge_base: List[Dict] = field(default_factory=list)  # stores past battle experiences
    last_action: str = ""
    last_action_time: float = 0.0
    
    def __post_init__(self):
        # Initialize power-ups
        self.power_ups = {power_type: 0.0 for power_type in PowerUpType}
    
    def apply_power_up(self, power_type: PowerUpType, duration: float, value: float):
        """Apply a power-up effect to the robot"""
        self.power_ups[power_type] = duration
        if power_type == PowerUpType.SPEED_BOOST:
            self.speed *= value
        elif power_type == PowerUpType.DAMAGE_BOOST:
            # This would affect the robot's weapon damage - stored in a separate field in a more complex system
            pass
        elif power_type == PowerUpType.SHIELD:
            # Shield would be implemented as temporary invulnerability
            pass
    
    def update_power_ups(self, delta_time: float):
        """Update active power-ups and remove expired ones"""
        for power_type in list(self.power_ups.keys()):
            if self.power_ups[power_type] > 0:
                self.power_ups[power_type] -= delta_time
                if self.power_ups[power_type] <= 0:
                    # Remove expired power-up
                    self.power_ups[power_type] = 0
                    # Revert speed if speed boost expired
                    if power_type == PowerUpType.SPEED_BOOST:
                        self.speed = ROBOT_SPEED
    
    def take_damage(self, damage: int):
        """Apply damage to the robot"""
        if not self.is_alive:
            return
        self.health -= damage
        if self.health <= 0:
            self.health = 0
            self.is_alive = False
            self.last_action = "died"
    
    def heal(self, amount: int):
        """Heal the robot"""
        if not self.is_alive:
            return
        self.health = min(self.max_health, self.health + amount)
    
    def can_act(self) -> bool:
        """Check if robot is ready to perform an action"""
        return self.is_alive and self.cooldown <= 0
    
    def update_cooldown(self, delta_time: float):
        """Update cooldown timer"""
        if self.cooldown > 0:
            self.cooldown -= delta_time
            if self.cooldown < 0:
                self.cooldown = 0
    
    def get_behavior_score(self) -> float:
        """Calculate a behavioral score based on past performance"""
        if not self.knowledge_base:
            return 0.5
        
        # Score based on kills, assists, objective completion, survival
        kills = sum(1 for entry in self.knowledge_base if entry.get('action') == 'kill')
        assists = sum(1 for entry in self.knowledge_base if entry.get('action') == 'assist')
        objectives = sum(1 for entry in self.knowledge_base if entry.get('action') == 'objective')
        survival = sum(entry.get('survived', 0) for entry in self.knowledge_base)
        total_battles = len(self.knowledge_base)
        
        if total_battles == 0:
            return 0.5
        
        score = (kills * 0.4 + assists * 0.3 + objectives * 0.2 + survival * 0.1) / total_battles
        return max(0.1, min(0.9, score))  # Clamp between 0.1 and 0.9

@dataclass
class Objective:
    """Represents a team-based objective in the arena"""
    id: int
    type: ObjectiveType
    position: Vector2
    team_required: Optional[int] = None  # None for neutral objectives
    captured_by: Optional[int] = None  # team_id that captured it
    progress: float = 0.0  # 0.0 to 1.0
    radius: float = 100.0
    capture_rate: float = 0.01  # per second
    defense_points: int = 5  # for base defense
    
    def is_captured(self) -> bool:
        return self.captured_by is not None
    
    def capture(self, team_id: int) -> bool:
        """Attempt to capture objective"""
        if self.type == ObjectiveType.BASE_DEFENSE:
            # Can only capture if defense points are depleted
            if self.defense_points <= 0:
                self.captured_by = team_id
                return True
            return False
        else:
            # For other types, capture based on progress
            self.captured_by = team_id
            return True
    
    def update(self, delta_time: float, robots_in_range: List[Robot]):
        """Update objective state"""
        if self.is_captured():
            return
        
        # Calculate progress based on robots from the required team
        if self.team_required is not None:
            friendly_robots = [r for r in robots_in_range if r.team == self.team_required and r.is_alive]
            enemy_robots = [r for r in robots_in_range if r.team != self.team_required and r.is_alive]
            
            if friendly_robots and self.type == ObjectiveType.FLAG_CAPTURE:
                self.progress += len(friendly_robots) * self.capture_rate * delta_time
            elif enemy_robots and self.type == ObjectiveType.FLAG_CAPTURE:
                self.progress -= len(enemy_robots) * self.capture_rate * delta_time * 0.5
            
            # For base defense, count enemy robots near
            elif self.type == ObjectiveType.BASE_DEFENSE:
                self.defense_points -= len(enemy_robots) * delta_time * 0.5
                self.defense_points = max(0, self.defense_points)
            
            # For payload escort, progress if robots are near
            elif self.type == ObjectiveType.PAYLOAD_ESCORT:
                if friendly_robots:
                    self.progress += len(friendly_robots) * self.capture_rate * delta_time
                else:
                    self.progress -= delta_time * 0.005
            
            # Clamp progress
            self.progress = max(0.0, min(1.0, self.progress))
            
            # If objective is fully captured
            if self.progress >= 1.0:
                self.capture(self.team_required)

class RobotBehavior:
    """Handles AI decision-making for robots"""
    
    def __init__(self, game_state: 'CyberArena'):
        self.game_state = game_state
        self.behavior_tree = {}
        self.init_behavior_tree()

        """Initialize behavior tree structure"""
        self.behavior_tree = {
            'priority': [
                self.check_health,
                self.check_objective,
                self.check_enemy_near,
                self.check_powerup,
                self.check_team_support,
                self.patrol
            ]
        }
    
    def check_health(self, robot: Robot) -> Optional[str]:
        """Check if robot needs to heal or retreat"""
        if robot.health < robot.max_health * 0.3 and robot.weapon != WeaponType.HEAL:
            # Look for healing power-up or teammate with heal
            nearby_heal = self.find_nearby_heal(robot)
            if nearby_heal:
                return f"seek_heal_{nearby_heal}"
            
            # Retreat to base or safe zone
            return "retreat"
        elif robot.health < robot.max_health * 0.6:
            # Use heal weapon if available
            if robot.weapon == WeaponType.HEAL and robot.can_act():
                return "heal_self"
        return None
    
    def find_nearby_heal(self, robot: Robot) -> Optional[int]:
        """Find a teammate with heal power-up or weapon"""
        for other_robot in self.game_state.robots.values():
            if (other_robot.team == robot.team and 
                other_robot.is_alive and 
                other_robot.weapon == WeaponType.HEAL and
                robot.position.distance_to(other_robot.position) < ROBOT_RANGE):
                return other_robot.id
        return None
    
    def check_objective(self, robot: Robot) -> Optional[str]:
        """Check for objective opportunities"""
        # Find closest objective
        closest_obj = None
        min_dist = float('inf')
        
        for obj in self.game_state.objectives.values():
            if not obj.is_captured():
                dist = robot.position.distance_to(obj.position)
                if dist < min_dist:
                    min_dist = dist
                    closest_obj = obj
        
        if closest_obj and min_dist < 300:
            # Determine if we should capture or defend
            if closest_obj.team_required is None or closest_obj.team_required == robot.team:
                return f"capture_{closest_obj.id}"
            else:
                # Enemy objective - attack or defend
                if robot.role == Role.ATTACKER or robot.role == Role.SCOUT:
                    return f"attack_objective_{closest_obj.id}"
                elif robot.role == Role.DEFENDER:
                    return f"defend_objective_{closest_obj.id}"
        
        return None
    
    def check_enemy_near(self, robot: Robot) -> Optional[str]:
        """Check for nearby enemies"""
        # Find closest enemy
        closest_enemy = None
        min_dist = float('inf')
        
        for other_robot in self.game_state.robots.values():
            if (other_robot.team != robot.team and 
                other_robot.is_alive and

                if dist < min_dist:

                    closest_enemy = other_robot

            # Determine action based on distance and weapon
            if distance <= ROBOT_MELEE_RANGE and robot.weapon in [WeaponType.MELEE, WeaponType.ROCKET]:
                return f"melee_attack_{closest_enemy.id}"
            elif distance <= ROBOT_RANGE and robot.weapon in [WeaponType.RANGED, WeaponType.SNIPER]:
                return f"ranged_attack_{closest_enemy.id}"
            elif distance > ROBOT_RANGE:
                return f"approach_{closest_enemy.id}"
        
        return None
    
    def check_powerup(self, robot: Robot) -> Optional[str]:
        """Check for nearby power-ups"""
        for powerup in self.game_state.powerups.values():

                if powerup.type == PowerUpType.SPEED_BOOST:

                elif powerup.type == PowerUpType.DAMAGE_BOOST:

    def check_team_support(self, robot: Robot) -> Optional[str]:

                teammate != robot and

@dataclass
class Vector2:
    """2D Vector for position and movement"""
    x: float = 0.0
    y: float = 0.0
    
    def __add__(self, other):
        return Vector2(self.x + other.x, self.y + other.y)
    
    def __sub__(self, other):
        return Vector2(self.x - other.x, self.y - other.y)
    
    def __mul__(self, scalar):
        return Vector2(self.x * scalar, self.y * scalar)
    
    def length(self):
        return math.sqrt(self.x**2 + self.y**2)
    
    def normalize(self):
        len_val = self.length()
        if len_val == 0:
            return Vector2(0, 0)
        return Vector2(self.x / len_val, self.y / len_val)
    
    def distance_to(self, other):
        return (self - other).length()

@dataclass

    id: int

    cooldown: float = 0.0
    is_alive: bool = True

    objective: Optional[ObjectiveType] = None
    power_ups: Dict[PowerUpType, float] = field(default_factory=dict)  # power-up type -> duration
    knowledge_base: List[Dict] = field(default_factory=list)  # stores past battle experiences
    last_action: str = ""
    last_action_time: float = 0.0
    
    def __post_init__(self):
        # Initialize power-ups
        self.power_ups = {power_type: 0.0 for power_type in PowerUpType}
    
    def apply_power_up(self, power_type: PowerUpType, duration: float, value: float):
        """Apply a power-up effect to the robot"""
        self.power_ups[power_type] = duration
        if power_type == PowerUpType.SPEED_BOOST:
            self.speed *= value
        elif power_type == PowerUpType.DAMAGE_BOOST:
            # This would affect the robot's weapon damage - stored in a separate field in a more complex system
            pass
        elif power_type == PowerUpType.SHIELD:
            # Shield would be implemented as temporary invulnerability
            pass
    
    def update_power_ups(self, delta_time: float):
        """Update active power-ups and remove expired ones"""
        for power_type in list(self.power_ups.keys()):
            if self.power_ups[power_type] > 0:
                self.power_ups[power_type] -= delta_time
                if self.power_ups[power_type] <= 0:
                    # Remove expired power-up
                    self.power_ups[power_type] = 0
                    # Revert speed if speed boost expired
                    if power_type == PowerUpType.SPEED_BOOST:
                        self.speed = ROBOT_SPEED
    
    def take_damage(self, damage: int):
        """Apply damage to the robot"""
        if not self.is_alive:
            return
        self.health -= damage
        if self.health <= 0:
            self.health = 0
            self.is_alive = False
            self.last_action = "died"
    
    def heal(self, amount: int):
        """Heal the robot"""
        if not self.is_alive:
            return
        self.health = min(self.max_health, self.health + amount)
    
    def can_act(self) -> bool:
        """Check if robot is ready to perform an action"""
        return self.is_alive and self.cooldown <= 0
    
    def update_cooldown(self, delta_time: float):
        """Update cooldown timer"""
        if self.cooldown > 0:
            self.cooldown -= delta_time
            if self.cooldown < 0:
                self.cooldown = 0
    
    def get_behavior_score(self) -> float:
        """Calculate a behavioral score based on past performance"""
        if not self.knowledge_base:
            return 0.5
        
        # Score based on kills, assists, objective completion, survival
        kills = sum(1 for entry in self.knowledge_base if entry.get('action') == 'kill')
        assists = sum(1 for entry in self.knowledge_base if entry.get('action') == 'assist')
        objectives = sum(1 for entry in self.knowledge_base if entry.get('action') == 'objective')
        survival = sum(entry.get('survived', 0) for entry in self.knowledge_base)
        total_battles = len(self.knowledge_base)
        
        if total_battles == 0:

        score = (kills * 0.4 + assists * 0.3 + objectives * 0.2 + survival * 0.1) / total_battles

@dataclass
class Objective:
    """Represents a team-based objective in the arena"""
    id: int
    type: ObjectiveType
    position: Vector2
    team_required: Optional[int] = None  # None for neutral objectives
    captured_by: Optional[int] = None  # team_id that captured it
    progress: float = 0.0  # 0.0 to 1.0
    radius: float = 100.0
    capture_rate: float = 0.01  # per second
    defense_points: int = 5  # for base defense
    
    def is_captured(self) -> bool:
        return self.captured_by is not None
    
    def capture(self, team_id: int) -> bool:
        """Attempt to capture objective"""
        if self.type == ObjectiveType.BASE_DEFENSE:
            # Can only capture if defense points are depleted
            if self.defense_points <= 0:
                self.captured_by = team_id
                return True
            return False
        else:
            # For other types, capture based on progress
            self.captured_by = team_id
            return True
    
    def update(self, delta_time: float, robots_in_range: List[Robot]):
        """Update objective state"""
        if self.is_captured():
            return
        
        # Calculate progress based on robots from the required team
        if self.team_required is not None:
            friendly_robots = [r for r in robots_in_range if r.team == self.team_required and r.is_alive]
            enemy_robots = [r for r in robots_in_range if r.team != self.team_required and r.is_alive]
            
            if friendly_robots and self.type == ObjectiveType.FLAG_CAPTURE:
                self.progress += len(friendly_robots) * self.capture_rate * delta_time
            elif enemy_robots and self.type == ObjectiveType.FLAG_CAPTURE:
                self.progress -= len(enemy_robots) * self.capture_rate * delta_time * 0.5
            
            # For base defense, count enemy robots near
            elif self.type == ObjectiveType.BASE_DEFENSE:
                self.defense_points -= len(enemy_robots) * delta_time * 0.5
                self.defense_points = max(0, self.defense_points)
            
            # For payload escort, progress if robots are near
            elif self.type == ObjectiveType.PAYLOAD_ESCORT:
                if friendly_robots:
                    self.progress += len(friendly_robots) * self.capture_rate * delta_time
                else:
                    self.progress -= delta_time * 0.005
            
            # Clamp progress
            self.progress = max(0.0, min(1.0, self.progress))
            
            # If objective is fully captured
            if self.progress >= 1.0:
                self.capture(self.team_required)

class RobotBehavior:
    """Handles AI decision-making for robots"""
    
    def __init__(self, game_state: 'CyberArena'):
        self.game_state = game_state
        self.behavior_tree = {}
        self.init_behavior_tree()
    
    def init_behavior_tree(self):
        """Initialize behavior tree structure"""
        self.behavior_tree = {
            'priority': [
                self.check_health,
                self.check_objective,
                self.check_enemy_near,
                self.check_powerup,
                self.check_team_support,
                self.patrol
            ]
        }
    
    def check_health(self, robot: Robot) -> Optional[str]:
        """Check if robot needs to heal or retreat"""
        if robot.health < robot.max_health * 0.3 and robot.weapon != WeaponType.HEAL:
            # Look for healing power-up or teammate with heal
            nearby_heal = self.find_nearby_heal(robot)
            if nearby_heal:
                return f"seek_heal_{nearby_heal}"
            
            # Retreat to base or safe zone
            return "retreat"
        elif robot.health < robot.max_health * 0.6:
            # Use heal weapon if available
            if robot.weapon == WeaponType.HEAL and robot.can_act():
                return "heal_self"
        return None
    
    def find_nearby_heal(self, robot: Robot) -> Optional[int]:
        """Find a teammate with heal power-up or weapon"""
        for other_robot in self.game_state.robots.values():
            if (other_robot.team == robot.team and 
                other_robot.is_alive and 
                other_robot.weapon == WeaponType.HEAL and
                robot.position.distance_to(other_robot.position) < ROBOT_RANGE):
                return other_robot.id
        return None
    
    def check_objective(self, robot: Robot) -> Optional[str]:
        """Check for objective opportunities"""
        # Find closest objective
        closest_obj = None
        min_dist = float('inf')
        
        for obj in self.game_state.objectives.values():
            if not obj.is_captured():
                dist = robot.position.distance_to(obj.position)
                if dist < min_dist:
                    min_dist = dist
                    closest_obj = obj
        
        if closest_obj and min_dist < 300:
            # Determine if we should capture or defend
            if closest_obj.team_required is None or closest_obj.team_required == robot.team:
                return f"capture_{closest_obj.id}"
            else:
                # Enemy objective - attack or defend
                if robot.role == Role.ATTACKER or robot.role == Role.SCOUT:
                    return f"attack_objective_{closest_obj.id}"
                elif robot.role == Role.DEFENDER:
                    return f"defend_objective_{closest_obj.id}"
        
        return None
    
    def check_enemy_near(self, robot: Robot) -> Optional[str]:
        """Check for nearby enemies"""
        # Find closest enemy
        closest_enemy = None
        min_dist = float('inf')
        
        for other_robot in self.game_state.robots.values():
            if (other_robot.team != robot.team and 
                other_robot.is_alive and
                robot.position.distance_to(other_robot.position) < ROBOT_RANGE):
                dist = robot.position.distance_to(other_robot.position)
                if dist < min_dist:
                    min_dist = dist
                    closest_enemy = other_robot
        
        if closest_enemy:
            distance = min_dist
            # Determine action based on distance and weapon
            if distance <= ROBOT_MELEE_RANGE and robot.weapon in [WeaponType.MELEE, WeaponType.ROCKET]:
                return f"melee_attack_{closest_enemy.id}"
            elif distance <= ROBOT_RANGE and robot.weapon in [WeaponType.RANGED, WeaponType.SNIPER]:
                return f"ranged_attack_{closest_enemy.id}"
            elif distance > ROBOT_RANGE:
                return f"approach_{closest_enemy.id}"
        
        return None
    
    def check_powerup(self, robot: Robot) -> Optional[str]:
        """Check for nearby power-ups"""
        for powerup in self.game_state.powerups.values():
            if powerup.active and robot.position.distance_to(powerup.position) < 150:
                # Prioritize certain power-ups
                if powerup.type == PowerUpType.SPEED_BOOST:
                    return f"grab_speed_{powerup.id}"
                elif powerup.type == PowerUpType.DAMAGE_BOOST:
                    return f"grab_damage_{powerup.id}"
                elif powerup.type == PowerUpType.SHIELD:
                    return f"grab_shield_{powerup.id}"
                elif powerup.type == PowerUpType.REGEN:
                    return f"grab_regen_{powerup.id}"
        
        return None
    
    def check_team_support(self, robot: Robot) -> Optional[str]:
        """Check if team needs support"""
        # Find teammates in danger or needing support
        for teammate in self.game_state.robots.values():
            if (teammate.team == robot.team and 
                teammate.is_alive and 
                teammate != robot and
                teammate.health < teammate.max_health * 0.5):
                
                # We're support role - go help
                if robot.role == Role.SUPPORT:
                    return f"heal_teammate_{teammate.id}"
                
                # We're defender - protect teammate
                if robot.role == Role.DEFENDER:
                    # Move to position between teammate and nearest enemy

        return None
    
    def find_nearest_enemy(self, robot: Robot) -> Optional[Robot]:
        """Find the closest enemy to a robot"""
        closest_enemy = None

        for other_robot in self.game_state.robots.values():

    def patrol(self, robot: Robot) -> str:

        # Move toward patrol point

    def decide_action(self, robot: Robot) -> str:

        # Update robot's knowledge with current state

        return Vector2(self.x * scalar, self.y * scalar)
    
    def length(self):
        return math.sqrt(self.x**2 + self.y**2)
    
    def normalize(self):
        len_val = self.length()
        if len_val == 0:
            return Vector2(0, 0)
        return Vector2(self.x / len_val, self.y / len_val)
    
    def distance_to(self, other):
        return (self - other).length()

@dataclass
class Robot:
    """Represents an AI-controlled robot in the arena"""
    id: int
    team: int
    position: Vector2
    health: int = ROBOT_HEALTH
    max_health: int = ROBOT_HEALTH
    speed: float = ROBOT_SPEED
    weapon: WeaponType = WeaponType.RANGED
    role: Role = Role.ATTACKER
    cooldown: float = 0.0
    is_alive: bool = True
    target: Optional[int] = None  # ID of target robot
    objective: Optional[ObjectiveType] = None
    power_ups: Dict[PowerUpType, float] = field(default_factory=dict)  # power-up type -> duration
    knowledge_base: List[Dict] = field(default_factory=list)  # stores past battle experiences
    last_action: str = ""
    last_action_time: float = 0.0
    
    def __post_init__(self):
        # Initialize power-ups
        self.power_ups = {power_type: 0.0 for power_type in PowerUpType}
    
    def apply_power_up(self, power_type: PowerUpType, duration: float, value: float):
        """Apply a power-up effect to the robot"""
        self.power_ups[power_type] = duration
        if power_type == PowerUpType.SPEED_BOOST:
            self.speed *= value
        elif power_type == PowerUpType.DAMAGE_BOOST:
            # This would affect the robot's weapon damage - stored in a separate field in a more complex system
            pass
        elif power_type == PowerUpType.SHIELD:
            # Shield would be implemented as temporary invulnerability
            pass
    
    def update_power_ups(self, delta_time: float):
        """Update active power-ups and remove expired ones"""
        for power_type in list(self.power_ups.keys()):
            if self.power_ups[power_type] > 0:
                self.power_ups[power_type] -= delta_time
                if self.power_ups[power_type] <= 0:
                    # Remove expired power-up
                    self.power_ups[power_type] = 0
                    # Revert speed if speed boost expired
                    if power_type == PowerUpType.SPEED_BOOST:
                        self.speed = ROBOT_SPEED
    
    def take_damage(self, damage: int):
        """Apply damage to the robot"""
        if not self.is_alive:
            return
        self.health -= damage
        if self.health <= 0:
            self.health = 0
            self.is_alive = False
            self.last_action = "died"
    
    def heal(self, amount: int):
        """Heal the robot"""
        if not self.is_alive:
            return
        self.health = min(self.max_health, self.health + amount)
    
    def can_act(self) -> bool:
        """Check if robot is ready to perform an action"""
        return self.is_alive and self.cooldown <= 0
    
    def update_cooldown(self, delta_time: float):
        """Update cooldown timer"""
        if self.cooldown > 0:
            self.cooldown -= delta_time
            if self.cooldown < 0:
                self.cooldown = 0
    
    def get_behavior_score(self) -> float:
        """Calculate a behavioral score based on past performance"""
        if not self.knowledge_base:
            return 0.5
        
        # Score based on kills, assists, objective completion, survival
        kills = sum(1 for entry in self.knowledge_base if entry.get('action') == 'kill')
        assists = sum(1 for entry in self.knowledge_base if entry.get('action') == 'assist')
        objectives = sum(1 for entry in self.knowledge_base if entry.get('action') == 'objective')
        survival = sum(entry.get('survived', 0) for entry in self.knowledge_base)
        total_battles = len(self.knowledge_base)
        
        if total_battles == 0:
            return 0.5
        
        score = (kills * 0.4 + assists * 0.3 + objectives * 0.2 + survival * 0.1) / total_battles
        return max(0.1, min(0.9, score))  # Clamp between 0.1 and 0.9

@dataclass
class Objective:
    """Represents a team-based objective in the arena"""
    id: int
    type: ObjectiveType
    position: Vector2
    team_required: Optional[int] = None  # None for neutral objectives
    captured_by: Optional[int] = None  # team_id that captured it
    progress: float = 0.0  # 0.0 to 1.0
    radius: float = 100.0
    capture_rate: float = 0.01  # per second
    defense_points: int = 5  # for base defense
    
    def is_captured(self) -> bool:
        return self.captured_by is not None
    
    def capture(self, team_id: int) -> bool:
        """Attempt to capture objective"""
        if self.type == ObjectiveType.BASE_DEFENSE:
            # Can only capture if defense points are depleted
            if self.defense_points <= 0:
                self.captured_by = team_id
                return True
            return False
        else:
            # For other types, capture based on progress
            self.captured_by = team_id
            return True
    
    def update(self, delta_time: float, robots_in_range: List[Robot]):
        """Update objective state"""
        if self.is_captured():
            return
        
        # Calculate progress based on robots from the required team
        if self.team_required is not None:
            friendly_robots = [r for r in robots_in_range if r.team == self.team_required and r.is_alive]
            enemy_robots = [r for r in robots_in_range if r.team != self.team_required and r.is_alive]
            
            if friendly_robots and self.type == ObjectiveType.FLAG_CAPTURE:
                self.progress += len(friendly_robots) * self.capture_rate * delta_time
            elif enemy_robots and self.type == ObjectiveType.FLAG_CAPTURE:
                self.progress -= len(enemy_robots) * self.capture_rate * delta_time * 0.5
            
            # For base defense, count enemy robots near
            elif self.type == ObjectiveType.BASE_DEFENSE:
                self.defense_points -= len(enemy_robots) * delta_time * 0.5
                self.defense_points = max(0, self.defense_points)
            
            # For payload escort, progress if robots are near
            elif self.type == ObjectiveType.PAYLOAD_ESCORT:
                if friendly_robots:
                    self.progress += len(friendly_robots) * self.capture_rate * delta_time
                else:
                    self.progress -= delta_time * 0.005
            
            # Clamp progress
            self.progress = max(0.0, min(1.0, self.progress))
            
            # If objective is fully captured
            if self.progress >= 1.0:
                self.capture(self.team_required)

class RobotBehavior:
    """Handles AI decision-making for robots"""
    
    def __init__(self, game_state: 'CyberArena'):
        self.game_state = game_state
        self.behavior_tree = {}
        self.init_behavior_tree()
    
    def init_behavior_tree(self):
        """Initialize behavior tree structure"""
        self.behavior_tree = {
            'priority': [
                self.check_health,
                self.check_objective,
                self.check_enemy_near,
                self.check_powerup,
                self.check_team_support,
                self.patrol
            ]
        }
    
    def check_health(self, robot: Robot) -> Optional[str]:
        """Check if robot needs to heal or retreat"""
        if robot.health < robot.max_health * 0.3 and robot.weapon != WeaponType.HEAL:
            # Look for healing power-up or teammate with heal
            nearby_heal = self.find_nearby_heal(robot)
            if nearby_heal:
                return f"seek_heal_{nearby_heal}"
            
            # Retreat to base or safe zone
            return "retreat"
        elif robot.health < robot.max_health * 0.6:
            # Use heal weapon if available
            if robot.weapon == WeaponType.HEAL and robot.can_act():
                return "heal_self"
        return None
    
    def find_nearby_heal(self, robot: Robot) -> Optional[int]:
        """Find a teammate with heal power-up or weapon"""
        for other_robot in self.game_state.robots.values():
            if (other_robot.team == robot.team and 
                other_robot.is_alive and 
                other_robot.weapon == WeaponType.HEAL and
                robot.position.distance_to(other_robot.position) < ROBOT_RANGE):
                return other_robot.id
        return None
    
    def check_objective(self, robot: Robot) -> Optional[str]:
        """Check for objective opportunities"""
        # Find closest objective
        closest_obj = None
        min_dist = float('inf')
        
        for obj in self.game_state.objectives.values():
            if not obj.is_captured():
                dist = robot.position.distance_to(obj.position)
                if dist < min_dist:
                    min_dist = dist
                    closest_obj = obj
        
        if closest_obj and min_dist < 300:
            # Determine if we should capture or defend
            if closest_obj.team_required is None or closest_obj.team_required == robot.team:
                return f"capture_{closest_obj.id}"
            else:
                # Enemy objective - attack or defend
                if robot.role == Role.ATTACKER or robot.role == Role.SCOUT:
                    return f"attack_objective_{closest_obj.id}"
                elif robot.role == Role.DEFENDER:
                    return f"defend_objective_{closest_obj.id}"
        
        return None
    
    def check_enemy_near(self, robot: Robot) -> Optional[str]:
        """Check for nearby enemies"""
        # Find closest enemy
        closest_enemy = None
        min_dist = float('inf')
        
        for other_robot in self.game_state.robots.values():
            if (other_robot.team != robot.team and 
                other_robot.is_alive and
                robot.position.distance_to(other_robot.position) < ROBOT_RANGE):
                dist = robot.position.distance_to(other_robot.position)
                if dist < min_dist:
                    min_dist = dist
                    closest_enemy = other_robot
        
        if closest_enemy:
            distance = min_dist
            # Determine action based on distance and weapon
            if distance <= ROBOT_MELEE_RANGE and robot.weapon in [WeaponType.MELEE, WeaponType.ROCKET]:
                return f"melee_attack_{closest_enemy.id}"
            elif distance <= ROBOT_RANGE and robot.weapon in [WeaponType.RANGED, WeaponType.SNIPER]:
                return f"ranged_attack_{closest_enemy.id}"
            elif distance > ROBOT_RANGE:
                return f"approach_{closest_enemy.id}"
        
        return None
    
    def check_powerup(self, robot: Robot) -> Optional[str]:
        """Check for nearby power-ups"""
        for powerup in self.game_state.powerups.values():
            if powerup.active and robot.position.distance_to(powerup.position) < 150:
                # Prioritize certain power-ups
                if powerup.type == PowerUpType.SPEED_BOOST:
                    return f"grab_speed_{powerup.id}"
                elif powerup.type == PowerUpType.DAMAGE_BOOST:
                    return f"grab_damage_{powerup.id}"
                elif powerup.type == PowerUpType.SHIELD:
                    return f"grab_shield_{powerup.id}"
                elif powerup.type == PowerUpType.REGEN:
                    return f"grab_regen_{powerup.id}"
        
        return None
    
    def check_team_support(self, robot: Robot) -> Optional[str]:
        """Check if team needs support"""
        # Find teammates in danger or needing support
        for teammate in self.game_state.robots.values():
            if (teammate.team == robot.team and 
                teammate.is_alive and 
                teammate != robot and
                teammate.health < teammate.max_health * 0.5):
                
                # We're support role - go help
                if robot.role == Role.SUPPORT:
                    return f"heal_teammate_{teammate.id}"
                
                # We're defender - protect teammate
                if robot.role == Role.DEFENDER:
                    # Move to position between teammate and nearest enemy
                    nearest_enemy = self.find_nearest_enemy(teammate)
                    if nearest_enemy:
                        # Position between teammate and enemy
                        return f"protect_{teammate.id}"
        
        return None
    
    def find_nearest_enemy(self, robot: Robot) -> Optional[Robot]:
        """Find the closest enemy to a robot"""
        closest_enemy = None
        min_dist = float('inf')
        
        for other_robot in self.game_state.robots.values():
            if (other_robot.team != robot.team and 
                other_robot.is_alive):
                dist = robot.position.distance_to(other_robot.position)
                if dist < min_dist:
                    min_dist = dist
                    closest_enemy = other_robot
        
        return closest_enemy
    
    def patrol(self, robot: Robot) -> str:
        """Default patrol behavior"""
        # Patrol a predefined area based on role
        patrol_points = [
            Vector2(100, 100), Vector2(900, 100), Vector2(900, 700), Vector2(100, 700),
            Vector2(400, 200), Vector2(600, 600), Vector2(500, 400)
        ]
        
        # Assign patrol points based on team and role
        team_offset = robot.team % len(patrol_points)
        role_offset = robot.role.value[0]  # Use first letter of role as offset
        
        # Get patrol point based on team and role
        point_idx = (team_offset + role_offset) % len(patrol_points)
        target_pos = patrol_points[point_idx]
        
        # Move toward patrol point
        return f"patrol_{target_pos.x}_{target_pos.y}"
    
    def decide_action(self, robot: Robot) -> str:
        """Main decision function - returns the next action"""
        if not robot.is_alive:
            return "dead"
        
        # Update robot's knowledge with current state
        robot.last_action_time = time.time()
        
        # Go through behavior tree priorities
        for behavior in self.behavior_tree['priority']:
            action = behavior(robot)
            if action:
                robot.last_action = action
                return action
        
        # Default behavior
        return "patrol"

class CyberArena:
    """Main game class managing the entire simulation"""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.robots: Dict[int, Robot] = {}
        self.objectives: Dict[int, Objective] = {}
        self.powerups: Dict[int, PowerUp] = {}
        self.hazards: Dict[int, Hazard] = {}
        self.stats = GameStats()
        self.time = 0.0
        self.delta_time = 0.0
        self.last_update = time.time()
        self.running = False
        self.game_mode = "team_deathmatch"  # or "capture_the_flag", "payload_escort", etc.
        self.adaptive_difficulty = 1.0  # 0.5 to 2.0
        
        # AI behavior system
        self.behavior_engine = RobotBehavior(self)
        
        # Audio and visual effects queues
        self.audio_effects = queue.Queue()
        self.visual_effects = queue.Queue()
        
        # Learning system - stores past battles
        self.battle_history = []
        
        # Initialize game
        self.initialize_game()
    
    def initialize_game(self):
        """Initialize the game environment"""
        # Create teams and robots (4 teams, 3 robots each)
        for team_id in range(1, MAX_TEAMS + 1):
            for i in range(MAX_ROBOTS_PER_TEAM):
                robot_id = (team_id - 1) * MAX_ROBOTS_PER_TEAM + i + 1
                # Random position within team territory (simplified)
                base_x = 100 + (team_id - 1) * 200
                base_y = 200
                position = Vector2(
                    base_x + random.uniform(-50, 50),
                    base_y + random.uniform(-50, 50)
                )
                
                # Assign roles based on team and position
                role = Role.ATTACKER if i < 2 else Role.SUPPORT if i == 2 else Role.DEFENDER
                
                # Random weapon assignment
                weapons = [WeaponType.RANGED, WeaponType.MELEE, WeaponType.SNIPER, WeaponType.ROCKET, WeaponType.HEAL]
                weapon = random.choice(weapons)
                
                robot = Robot(
                    id=robot_id,
                    team=team_id,
                    position=position,
                    role=role,
                    weapon=weapon
                )
                self.robots[robot_id] = robot
        
        # Create objectives
        objective_positions = [
            Vector2(GAME_WIDTH/2, GAME_HEIGHT/2),  # Center flag
            Vector2(200, 200),  # Team 1 base
            Vector2(800, 600),  # Team 4 base
        ]
        
        objective_types = [
            ObjectiveType.FLAG_CAPTURE,
            ObjectiveType.BASE_DEFENSE,
            ObjectiveType.PAYLOAD_ESCORT
        ]
        
        for i, (pos, obj_type) in enumerate(zip(objective_positions, objective_types)):
            objective = Objective(
                id=i+1,
                type=obj_type,
                position=pos,
                team_required=None if obj_type == ObjectiveType.FLAG_CAPTURE else (i+1),
                radius=120,
                capture_rate=0.02 if obj_type == ObjectiveType.FLAG_CAPTURE else 0.01
            )
            self.objectives[i+1] = objective
        
        # Initialize power-ups
        self.spawn_powerups()
        
        # Initialize hazards
        self.spawn_hazards()
    
    def spawn_powerups(self):
        """Spawn initial power-ups"""
        powerup_positions = [
            Vector2(150, 600), Vector2(850, 200), Vector2(500, 150),
            Vector2(300, 400), Vector2(700, 400)
        ]
        
        powerup_types = list(PowerUpType)
        
        for i, pos in enumerate(powerup_positions):
            powerup_type = random.choice(powerup_types)
            powerup = PowerUp(
                id=i+1,
                type=powerup_type,
                position=pos,
                value=1.5,
                duration=10.0,
                spawn_time=self.time
            )

        # Schedule automatic power-up spawns
        threading.Timer(POWERUP_SPAWN_INTERVAL, self._auto_spawn_powerups).start()
    
    def _auto_spawn_powerups(self):
        """Automatically spawn power-ups at random locations"""
        if not self.running:
            return
        
        # Find empty positions
        used_positions = [p.position for p in self.powerups.values()]
        available_positions = []
        
        # Generate random positions that aren't too close to existing ones

            pos = Vector2(
                random.uniform(100, GAME_WIDTH-100),
                random.uniform(100, GAME_HEIGHT-100)
            )
            too_close = False
            for used_pos in used_positions:
                if pos.distance_to(used_pos) < 150:
                    too_close = True
                    break
            if not too_close:
                available_positions.append(pos)
        
        if available_positions:
            # Spawn one new power-up
            pos = random.choice(available_positions)
            powerup_type = random.choice(list(PowerUpType))
            new_id = max(self.powerups.keys(), default=0) + 1
            powerup = PowerUp(
                id=new_id,
                type=powerup_type,
                position=pos,
                value=1.5,
                duration=10.0,
                spawn_time=self.time

        # Schedule next spawn

    def update_adaptive_difficulty(self):
        """Adjust difficulty based on team performance"""
        if len(self.stats.team_scores) < 2:
            return
        
        # Calculate average scores
        scores = list(self.stats.team_scores.values())
        avg_score = sum(scores) / len(scores)
        max_score = max(scores)
        min_score = min(scores)
        
        # If one team is dominating significantly
        if max_score > avg_score * 2 and max_score > 20:
            self.adaptive_difficulty = max(0.5, self.adaptive_difficulty - 0.1)
        elif min_score < avg_score * 0.5 and min_score < 5:
            self.adaptive_difficulty = min(2.0, self.adaptive_difficulty + 0.1)
        
        # Apply difficulty adjustments to AI behavior
        for robot in self.robots.values():
            if robot.team != max(self.stats.team_scores, key=self.stats.team_scores.get):
                # Weaker team gets slightly smarter AI
                pass  # In a real implementation, this would adjust decision weights
    
    def update(self, delta_time: float):
        """Main game update loop"""
        self.delta_time = delta_time
        self.time += delta_time
        
        # Update each robot
        for robot_id, robot in list(self.robots.items()):
            if not robot.is_alive:
                continue
            
            # Update cooldown
            robot.update_cooldown(delta_time)
            
            # Update power-ups
            robot.update_power_ups(delta_time)
            
            # Get AI decision
            action = self.behavior_engine.decide_action(robot)
            
            # Execute action
            self.execute_action(robot, action)
            
            # Update knowledge base
            self.update_knowledge_base(robot)
        
        # Update objectives
        for obj_id, objective in list(self.objectives.items()):
            # Get robots in range of objective
            robots_in_range = [
                r for r in self.robots.values() 
                if r.is_alive and r.position.distance_to(objective.position) < objective.radius
            ]
            objective.update(delta_time, robots_in_range)
            
            # Check if objective was captured
            if objective.is_captured() and objective.captured_by is not None:
                self.stats.objectives_completed[objective.type] += 1
                self.stats.update_team_score(objective.captured_by, 10)
                self.audio_effects.put(("objective_captured", objective.position))
        
        # Update power-ups
        for powerup_id, powerup in list(self.powerups.items()):
            if powerup.active:
                # Check if any robot is close enough to pick it up
                for robot in self.robots.values():
                    if (robot.is_alive and 
                        robot.position.distance_to(powerup.position) < 50):

                        robot.apply_power_up(powerup.type, powerup.duration, powerup.value)

   - Frontend: Develop a user-friendly interface that allows coaches and athletes to input and manage training and game data.     x: float = 0.0

    def distance_to(self, other: 'Position') -> float:
        return math.sqrt((self.x - other.x)**2 + (self.y - other.y)**2 + (self.z - other.z)**2)
    
    def __add__(self, other: 'Position') -> 'Position':
        return Position(self.x + other.x, self.y + other.y, self.z + other.z)
    
    def __sub__(self, other: 'Position') -> 'Position':
        return Position(self.x - other.x, self.y - other.y, self.z - other.z)
    
    def normalize(self) -> 'Position':
        mag = math.sqrt(self.x**2 + self.y**2 + self.z**2)
        if mag == 0:
            return Position(0, 0, 0)
        return Position(self.x/mag, self.y/mag, self.z/mag)

            if power_up == PowerUpType.SPEED_BOOST:
                self.speed = 1.5 * (self.speed if hasattr(self, 'speed') else 1.0)
            elif power_up == PowerUpType.SHIELD:
                self.armor = min(100.0, self.armor * 2)
            elif power_up == PowerUpType.INVINCIBILITY:
                pass  # Invincibility is handled in damage calculation
            elif power_up == PowerUpType.HEALTH_PACK:
                self.heal(20.0)
    
    def can_see(self, target_position: Position) -> bool:
        # Simplified line of sight - check if within vision range
        return self.position.distance_to(target_position) <= self.vision_range
    
    def get_nearest_enemy(self, enemies: List['Robot']) -> Optional['Robot']:
        if not enemies:
            return None
        
        visible_enemies = [e for e in enemies if self.can_see(e.position) and not e.is_dead]
        if not visible_enemies:
            return None
        
        return min(visible_enemies, key=lambda e: self.position.distance_to(e.position))
    
    def get_nearest_objective(self, objectives: List['Objective']) -> Optional['Objective']:
        if not objectives:
            return None
        
        return min(objectives, key=lambda o: self.position.distance_to(o.position))
    
    def get_team_members(self, team_robots: List['Robot']) -> List['Robot']:
        return [r for r in team_robots if r.team == self.team and not r.is_dead]
    
    def get_weapon_for_objective(self, objective: 'Objective') -> Optional[Weapon]:
        """Return the most suitable weapon for a given objective type"""
        if objective.type == ObjectiveType.FLAG_CAPTURE:
            # For capture, balanced weapon is best
            return next((w for w in self.weapons if w.type in [WeaponType.RANGED, WeaponType.MELEE]), None)
        elif objective.type == ObjectiveType.BASE_DEFENSE:
            # Defense favors area damage or high damage
            return next((w for w in self.weapons if w.type in [WeaponType.EXPLOSIVE, WeaponType.RANGED]), None)
        elif objective.type == ObjectiveType.PAYLOAD_ESCORT:
            # Escort requires mobility and ranged defense
            return next((w for w in self.weapons if w.type in [WeaponType.RANGED, WeaponType.SUPPORT]), None)
        else:
            return self.get_current_weapon()

@dataclass
class Objective:
    id: str
    type: ObjectiveType
    position: Position
    team: Team
    captured_by: Optional[Team] = None
    progress: float = 0.0
    capture_radius: float = 8.0
    required_allies: int = 2  # Number of team members needed to capture
    is_active: bool = True
    
    def update(self, robots: List[Robot], delta_time: float):
        if not self.is_active:
            return
            
        # Find robots in capture radius of the same team
        allies_in_radius = [
            r for r in robots 
            if r.team == self.team and not r.is_dead and 
            r.position.distance_to(self.position) <= self.capture_radius
        ]
        
        if len(allies_in_radius) >= self.required_allies:
            # Capture progress increases
            self.progress += delta_time * (0.5 if len(allies_in_radius) >= self.required_allies + 1 else 0.2)
            if self.progress >= 1.0:
                self.captured_by = self.team
                self.progress = 1.0
                self.is_active = False
        else:
            # If no allies or fewer than required, progress decreases if owned by opponent
            if self.captured_by and self.captured_by != self.team:
                self.progress -= delta_time * 0.1
                if self.progress <= 0:
                    self.captured_by = None
                    self.progress = 0.0

@dataclass
class PowerUp:
    type: PowerUpType
    position: Position
    active: bool = True
    spawn_time: float = field(default_factory=lambda: time.time())
    duration: float = 30.0  # How long it stays active
    effect_duration: float = 10.0  # How long the effect lasts when picked up
    
    def update(self, delta_time: float):
        if self.active:
            if time.time() - self.spawn_time > self.duration:
                self.active = False

@dataclass
class Hazard:
    type: HazardType
    position: Position
    radius: float
    damage_per_second: float
    active: bool = True
    spawn_time: float = field(default_factory=lambda: time.time())
    duration: float = 60.0
    
    def update(self, delta_time: float):
        if self.active:
            if time.time() - self.spawn_time > self.duration:
                self.active = False

@dataclass
class ScoringSystem:
    team_scores: Dict[Team, int] = field(default_factory=lambda: {Team.RED: 0, Team.BLUE: 0})
    objective_scores: Dict[ObjectiveType, int] = field(default_factory=dict)
    team_assists: Dict[Team, int] = field(default_factory=lambda: {Team.RED: 0, Team.BLUE: 0})
    kills: Dict[Team, int] = field(default_factory=lambda: {Team.RED: 0, Team.BLUE: 0})
    
    def add_score(self, team: Team, points: int):
        self.team_scores[team] += points
        
    def add_assist(self, team: Team):
        self.team_assists[team] += 1
        
    def add_kill(self, team: Team):
        self.kills[team] += 1
    
    def get_team_score(self, team: Team) -> int:
        return self.team_scores[team]
    
    def get_leader(self) -> Optional[Team]:
        if self.team_scores[Team.RED] > self.team_scores[Team.BLUE]:
            return Team.RED
        elif self.team_scores[Team.BLUE] > self.team_scores[Team.RED]:
            return Team.BLUE
        return None
